summary: CN Energy Group filed a routine Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements for the fiscal half-year ended March 31, 2026, along with related XBRL exhibits. No special-situation transaction is disclosed: there is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private proposal, activist stake, strategic review, or capital-return event announced in the excerpt. The filing merely satisfies ongoing reporting obligations for a foreign private issuer, covering segment results and convertible note references. No deal terms, premiums, advisor, or board recommendation appear. For event-driven purposes, this is non-actionable; watch only for future 6-K disclosures on financings or corporate actions.
